retrieval.scope: Four aggregate observed public-data results plus one separately categorized identifier-free, deterministic 10% user-level session-model result for educational conversion-model evaluation; no raw event-level records or unique identifiers were downloaded or committed.

source_public_data_retrieval_metadata.scope: Observed Google public-sample query, job, and result hashes for both aggregate outputs and separately categorized identifier-free session-model data; not a raw event snapshot.

observed_identifier_free_session_model_d.scope: One-row-per-session observed public-data model input with a non-unique split bucket; no raw user, session, event, or transaction identifier.

synthetic_test_fixture.scope: Small deterministic synthetic schema test fixture only; not observed Google data and not a public-data snapshot.

limitations: The fixture validates schema handling only and must not be used to infer public-source distributions or outcomes.

Aggregate findings are computed from compact observed aggregate outputs, while the conversion model is computed only from the separately categorized identifier-free session-model output; neither uses the synthetic fixture.
The public sample is obfuscated; aggregate paths omit user, session, transaction, and hashed identifiers.
